The last opponent mon is Mega Steelix with Sand Force and a massive base 230 Defense, which spells trouble since my Kingambit at 43 HP won't survive an Earthquake. I'm checking whether Gholdengo's Steel/Ghost typing gives me a safer answer.

Running the numbers, Gholdengo's Focus Blast is super effective but only a roll of 131-154 damage against Steelix's ~150-182 max HP, not a guaranteed KO and at 70% accuracy too, while Steelix's own Earthquake comfortably two-shots or even one-shots Gholdengo given its weak Defense against Ground. Kingambit's Kowtow Cleave with Supreme Overlord also falls well short of breaking through Steelix's defenses, and Sucker Punch won't help if Steelix just attacks first — none of my remaining options look like clean kills, so my win condition here is shaky.

Kowtow Cleave seems like the better choice since it hits regardless of whether Steelix attacks, guaranteeing damage if I'm faster than a slow Steelix. Swords Dance is too risky since I'd die before using it.
